Fair price kaun tay karta hai? 🤝

Fair price wo bhaav hai jise buyer aur seller dono theek samajhte hain. Price usse bahut upar jaye to buyers peeche hat sakte hain, bahut neeche jaye to sellers. Market isi value ke aas-paas ghoomta hai.
